verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described Uplink, which exposed an MCP server 'running on any machine as a regular Smithery connection' so a team could run a private tool without hosting it. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Connect and API connection-management services stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a public, non-proxied registry. With no managed connection layer left, the product no longer delivers this bridge, and both sides of the evidence are first-party docs, so this is not a cross-tier dispute.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
